scope: Nine evidence-bounded anchor mappings spanning all six primary product pillars (including the canonical audit's top-five clinical candidates); no clinical benefit is claimed.

entries.humanProblem: Unreviewed or mismatched diagnosis coding can propagate into a longitudinal encounter

outcomeMetric.name: Clinician-approved ICD-10 provenance linkage rate
outcomeMetric.numerator: Eligible encounter diagnoses with clinician-approved, provenance-linked ICD-10 code
outcomeMetric.denominator: Eligible encounter diagnoses requiring ICD-10 coding
outcomeMetric.measurementPlan: Prospective paired coding concordance audit vs certified clinical coders; stratify by diagnosis complexity

entries.safetyBoundary: Coding suggestions must remain drafts until qualified clinician review; do not write diagnoses autonomously

entries.humanProblem: Lab results can be left unreconciled with diagnostic orders and longitudinal milestones

outcomeMetric.name: Verified diagnostic result reconciliation rate
outcomeMetric.numerator: Eligible diagnostic results reconciled to the correct order and reviewed by authorized clinician
outcomeMetric.denominator: All eligible diagnostic results returned for the study cohort
outcomeMetric.measurementPlan: Compare time-to-reconciliation and orphaned-result rates with a baseline lab inbox; audit accession identifiers

entries.safetyBoundary: Fulfillment alone is not clinician review or sign-off; mismatched IDs fail closed

entries.humanProblem: Administrative closure can hide unresolved problems or unsigned clinical decisions

outcomeMetric.name: Clinician-signed safe episode closure rate
outcomeMetric.numerator: Eligible completed episodes with signed outcome and no unresolved mandatory clinical obligations
outcomeMetric.denominator: All episodes eligible for closure in a predefined cohort
outcomeMetric.measurementPlan: Blinded review of closure records against chart and unresolved-task reference standard

entries.safetyBoundary: No AI-signed clinical outcomes; unresolved critical obligations block closure

entries.humanProblem: Missing or synthetic vital signs can be mistaken for real normal measurements

outcomeMetric.name: Unverified vital-sign rejection rate
outcomeMetric.numerator: Known unverified or synthetic vital-sign inputs rejected at ingestion
outcomeMetric.denominator: All known unverified or synthetic vital-sign inputs presented during a prespecified evaluation
outcomeMetric.measurementPlan: Test synthetic and corrupted inputs; separately assess real authorized device ingestion for false rejection

entries.safetyBoundary: Absence is not zero; simulated values may never become signed patient measurements

entries.humanProblem: Clinical handoffs can lose pending tests, provenance, and responsibility across facilities

outcomeMetric.name: Acknowledged clinical handoff reconciliation rate
outcomeMetric.numerator: Eligible cross-facility handoffs acknowledged with patient identity and pending tasks reconciled
outcomeMetric.denominator: All eligible cross-facility handoffs in the measured cohort
outcomeMetric.measurementPlan: Paired receiving-clinician retrieval and checklist comparison to existing transfer summaries

entries.safetyBoundary: FHIR-aligned export is not proof of exchange interoperability or receiving-clinician acknowledgement

entries.humanProblem: Medical plans and discharge instructions may be difficult to understand without plain-language layered explanations

outcomeMetric.name: Clinician-reviewed patient comprehension rate
outcomeMetric.numerator: Participants correctly explaining prespecified diagnosis, warning signs and next steps after using reviewed plain-language content
outcomeMetric.denominator: Participants completing a structured post-explanation comprehension assessment
outcomeMetric.measurementPlan: Compare comprehension against a standard clinician-approved explanation using prospective paired or randomized evaluations; record health literacy strata

entries.safetyBoundary: Education only: no independent diagnosis, dosage modifications or concealment of red flags; clinician-signed plan remains authoritative

entries.humanProblem: Organ-to-cell reference navigation can confuse expression-based clusters with biological lineage or patient-specific pathology

outcomeMetric.name: Reference cell ontology concordance rate
outcomeMetric.numerator: Eligible atlas mappings independently concordant with a held-out annotated Cell Ontology reference
outcomeMetric.denominator: Eligible reference atlas mappings selected through a prespecified evaluation protocol
outcomeMetric.measurementPlan: Reproduce organ-to-cell harmonization on properly licensed public reference data and compare blinded Cell Ontology assignments

entries.safetyBoundary: Cell atlas display is a research reference, not a measured patient's cell state, cell lineage proof or validated diagnostic test

entries.humanProblem: CGM traces without sufficient provenance and hypoglycemia review can lead to unsafe insulin decision support
entries.observableWorkflowOutcome: Traceable clinician-reviewed CGM safety summary rate

outcomeMetric.name: Traceable clinician-reviewed CGM safety summary rate
outcomeMetric.numerator: Eligible 14-day CGM reviews with accepted source provenance, hypoglycemia flags and authorized clinician verification
outcomeMetric.denominator: Eligible permissioned CGM review encounters with adequate source data during the cohort period
outcomeMetric.measurementPlan: Review synthetically generated and independently permissioned CGM traces against clinician rubric; document missingness and false-negative hypoglycemia alerts

entries.safetyBoundary: CGM summaries are not autonomous medication orders; missing or unverified measurements fail closed and any treatment changes require clinician authority

entries.humanProblem: Post-discharge follow-up can be missed when operational care-continuity responsibilities are not acknowledged

outcomeMetric.name: Timely closed-loop post-discharge outreach rate
outcomeMetric.numerator: Eligible discharge episodes receiving documented outreach and resolution or appropriate escalation within prespecified timeframe
outcomeMetric.denominator: Discharge episodes meeting documented operational care-continuity outreach eligibility criteria
outcomeMetric.measurementPlan: Prospective comparison of outreach acknowledgement and unresolved escalation vs standard discharge follow-up; prespecify timeframe and exclusions

entries.safetyBoundary: Operational care-coordination flags are not calibrated readmission risk or individualized prognostic probabilities
